clause.description: Clause or section label, e.g. 'Schedule A, 2'.
clause.title: Clause

document.description: document_id exactly as returned by find_contract_files.
document.title: Document

page.description: 1-based page number the quote is on.
page.title: Page

quote.description: Exact words copied from that page, long enough to include the rate. Never paraphrase.
quote.title: Quote

effective_date.description: Date this rate starts (YYYY-MM-DD), per the contract.
effective_date.title: Effective Date

kind.description: 'rebate' (percent of a product's net sales) or 'admin_fee' (percent of total net sales).
kind.title: Kind

product.description: Product name as written in the contract; null for an admin fee.
product.title: Product

rate_pct.description: The rate as a percent number, e.g. 6 for 6%.
rate_pct.title: Rate Pct
